subject: Re: DPA / SCCs - order form locality & approval path
messages:
From: Megan Shaw <megan.shaw@nutrify.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@nutrify.com>, legal@nutrify.com
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: DPA redlines + SCCs questions

Hi Rafael / Laura —

Thanks for the call earlier. Attached are NutriFy's redlines to the Order Form and the DPA (see NutriFy_Redlines_OrderForm_DPA.docx). Two items are blocking our internal sign-off: 1) we need explicit execution of SCCs (Art. 46 flow) plus a Transfer Impact Addendum that confirms data routing and subprocessors for EU resident data; and 2) clarification on roles — NutriFy prefers controller-controller framing for analytics exports.

Can Redwood confirm:
- Whether you can commit to EU-only data residency for NutriFy accounts (pin to eu-central region) and an evidence affidavit for KMS handling?
- A subprocessor list with onboarding / removal notice SLA (we typically ask 30 days)
- Retention/deletion commitments aligned to our Data Subject Rights process

If you can provide a clean DPA with marked SCCs and a short answers doc we can route to procurement this week.

Appreciate a turnaround by 12/23 if possible — our procurement calendar is tight.

Thanks,
Megan Shaw
Senior Counsel, NutriFy
megan.shaw@nutrify.com

Attachment: NutriFy_Redlines_OrderForm_DPA.docx (marked redlines)

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Megan Shaw <megan.shaw@nutrify.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-20T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + SCCs questions

Megan —

Thanks for the redlines and the clear asks. Quick summary of what's feasible and our proposed path:

1) EU-only residency: we can pin NutriFy production datasets to eu-central-1 via an Order Form routing addendum. That will be reflected in the Order Form addendum (we will include a hosting_region field and an explicit routing policy). Note: logging/ops traces may be routed for operational reasons — we'll call that out and limit to metadata only.

2) SCCs: we will execute the EU SCCs (Module Two / Processor Addendum where applicable) and provide a Transfer Impact Addendum. Ben (cc'd) will propose limited language around dataflow descriptions and fallback routing.

3) Subprocessors / KMS / Evidence: we can provide the current subprocessor list and agree to 30 days notice for onboarding, 14 days for emergency removal communications. For KMS: Redwood manages keys in our customer KMS offering (you can bring-your-own-key via AWS KMS). We'll draft a short technical affidavit that confirms key residency and rotation policies.

Next steps from our side: Ben will send a mark-up of the DPA (we'll attach Redwood_DPA_v3_marked.pdf) and a separate one-page "SCCs & Routing FAQ" that addresses your bullet points. If that packaging looks good you can route to procurement and we can send DocuSign.

Proposed timeline: draft DPA to you by EOD 12/20, Ben's legal comments by 12/21, DocuSign-ready bundle by 12/22. Is that workable?

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v3_marked.pdf

From: Megan Shaw <megan.shaw@nutrify.com>

Rafael —

Thanks. Two quick clarifications before we escalate:
- Can you confirm the deletion confirmation process for account termination (we need export + wipe + certification within 30 days)?
- For BYOK, who is the custodian of KMS logs and do you provide audit evidence on key usage?

If Ben can fold those into the marked DPA it will speed internal review.

-Megan

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Megan Shaw <megan.shaw@nutrify.com>, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-21T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Redwood proposed DPA redline and SCCs approach

Hi Megan / Rafael / Laura —

Attached is Redwood_DPA_v3_marked.pdf with legal commentary. Highlights / proposals below (high-level):

- Roles: we'll keep the primary relationship as Controller (NutriFy) / Processor (Redwood) for inference outputs, but we will accept a short Order Form clause that clarifies certain analytics exports may be controller-controller. We propose a narrow carveout limited to anonymized aggregated reporting.

- SCCs: we'll incorporate the EU SCCs and a Transfer Impact Addendum that describes routing, subprocessors, and technical & organizational measures (encryption at rest/in transit, key management notes). We'll include an explicit reference to DocuSign-executed annexes so that the SCCs are applied automatically on signature.

- Deletion/Export: Redwood will commit to a 30-calendar day window for complete data export + deletion certification post-termination. We propose the following process clause: customer requests export -> Redwood delivers export package within 15 days -> Redwood performs certified wipe and supplies attestation within 30 days. (We can make exceptions where customer-managed backups extend this timeline; we'll document those.)

- KMS / logs: for BYOK, NutriFy will retain administrative control of keys; Redwood will provide access logs for key-use events as an auditable artifact. For Redwood-managed KMS, we will provide periodic key-use summaries and can provide ad-hoc evidence under NDA.

- Subprocessor notice: we accept 30-day notice for new subprocessors and 7-day emergency notice for security-critical onboarding. Removal notices will be handled per the Order Form ops contact.

Please see the attached PDF for line-by-line language. Key ask: confirm whether NutriFy is comfortable with the proposed controller-controller carveout for aggregated analytics (we kept it intentionally narrow).

If agreeable, Rafael — please confirm final Order Form routing addendum wording and we will prepare a DocuSign bundle.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v3_marked.pdf

On the deletion SLA and KMS evidence, please include the attestation templates (we'll need a short form for our privacy team).

Rafael — please keep me posted on the DocuSign link.

Alex Torres
